name: Vapula/Naphula
wishes: cross with per-arm flare flags: the bottom cross has a plain stem up to the rail instead of a flared top arm
a single flared arm or serif-foot primitive: the inner posts end in cross-pattee feet, approximated here by filled tri
notes: Symmetric frame with two inner posts on flared feet and a crossbar; a heart (two lobe arcs plus convex cheeks) hangs on a stem into the crossbar; rings under the sill and a flared cross below on a stem; each flank is an arch descending into seven repeated scallops that run into a clockwise curl joined to the frame's foot.
